reference_type: Independent author standard-method outcomes on all eight exact real files and their stitched observation; no actual screen-distance truth is available

definitions.maximum_kappa_relative_error: max over all9 conditions of abs(predicted kappa-original kappa)/original kappa
definitions.maximum_power_deficit_db: max over all9 conditions of max measured arc-power profile minus its linearly interpolated dB power at predicted kappa/(2e6)

basis: Frozen before local extraction. Deterministic original full rerun had all numeric array hashes identical.1% kappa tolerance is smaller than every source empirical noise-based error.0.5dB measured-power allowance retains a physical peak constraint without relabeling source reconstruction as actual truth.
acceptance_definition: Every one of the9 reported curvatures must lie within the observation-derived search profile and attain its maximum arc power within the existing0.5dB allowance. The original standard kappa discrepancy is diagnostic only and does not constrain acceptance.
